kakariko.name: KAKARIKO VILLAGE
kakariko.arrival: Under the mountain, carpenters mend beams and a windmill turns over the well. The mountain guard watches the northern gate.

people.name: Carpenter
lines: Impa opened this village to all sorts of people. Stoneworkers, farm hands, wanderers — everyone can leave something better than they found it.
The Gorons used to bring good stone down the mountain. We haven't seen a cart from their quarry in days.

people.name: Windmill Keeper
lines: Listen to the wooden arms creak. A steady wind and a patient wheel can keep a whole village supplied with water.
There is an old song in the rhythm, but I can't remember how it goes. Perhaps one day someone will remind me.

trail.name: DEATH MOUNTAIN TRAIL
trail.arrival: The road climbs in three bends. A cracked boulder closes the quarry on the first ledge; warm light marks Goron City at the top.

people.name: Hungry Goron
lines: We eat the good rocks from the quarry. A stranger sealed the entrance, and the beasts inside chased us away. Darunia hasn't smiled since.
A Bomb Flower could break that cracked rock. But those buds are heavy — ask our chief about the Goron's Bracelet.

goron.name: GORON CITY
goron.arrival: Rooms have been carved into the warm stone around a communal fire. Darunia's chamber lies behind the royal crest at the north end.

people.name: Goron Elder
lines: Our chief is waiting for a messenger from the royal family. Play the royal melody at the crest; he will know you came in good faith.
Darunia carries everyone's hunger on his shoulders. When he was young, a song from the forest could always make him dance.

people.name: Goron Smith
lines: Metal remembers the heat that shaped it. Our bracelets let a small hand lift a heavy Bomb Flower, but they won't slow a burning fuse.
C throws a lit bomb. E sets it down. Pick your place before lighting the fuse — then give the mountain room to answer.
